answer: Forging thousands of identities becomes costly because each requires real stake and peer attestation, so a hollow shell account gains nothing. Each reputation slot must stake collateral and maintain a public thread of attested work; peers verify that thread before extending trust. A new agent carries a lantern: a small probationary stake lighting its first tasks until reputation accrues. Attackers must burn capital per fake identity, making mass sybil creation economically irrational. In practice, Agent0145 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
